title: Eleven Minutes of Holding On
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：control　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 control 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 my grandfather ① took control of a habit that had taken eleven years to form, and he said the taking was the whole of the change. The ② control, meaning the holding and not the rule, lasted eleven minutes a day and stayed that size; control, he said, is the only thing in a day that is judged by how little of it is noticed.

Every ③ control in that house had the same clock, and the ④ control at the end, meaning the one he kept for the evenings and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever tested twice. Control, my grandmother said, is nine parts clock and one part somebody willing to hold on; my grandfather said the holding on is the part that fills eleven minutes.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the control was the whole of the experiment, meaning the comparison and not the holding. The ⑥ control, meaning the comparison and not any of that, is the only thing in an experiment that everybody needs and nobody writes up; control, she said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a holding and a comparison. He said the comparison is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ control had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the clock. The ⑧ control of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in January, was one habit and thirty years of holding on; control, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to notice. She said the noticing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ control I remember is the one at the end, which he kept in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ control, my grandmother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being tested; every control, she said, is a comparison that has agreed to look like a holding. She said the comparison was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 自制（指那种把持本身，与那条规矩相对）
C. 固定搭配：take control of 控制住、掌握
D. n. 自制（指那栋房子里每一次）
E. n. 自制（指末尾那一种）
F. n. 对照；对照组（实验中的对照）
G. n. 控制（指日记里提到的那一项）
H. n. 自制力；约束（抽象总称）

items.q: took control of a habit that had taken eleven years to form
The control, meaning the holding and not the rule
the control was the whole of the experiment
the control had become a line in a diary
The control of the whole thing
A control, my grandmother said in 1980

answers.why: take control of 意为“控制住、掌握”，1964 年祖父控制住一个花了十一年才养成的习惯。
control 意为“自制、把持”，指那种把持本身而不是那条规矩，每天只维持十一分钟。
control 指那栋房子里每一次自制，每一次都盯着同一个钟。
control 指末尾那一种（他留给晚上的那一种），是唯一有人考验过两次的。
control 意为“对照、对照组”，母亲说对照组就是那场实验的全部，指的是对照而不是那种把持。
control 为科学用法，指实验的对照组而不是那种把持，是实验里人人都需要、却无人写进报告的东西。
control 意为“控制”，指日记里提到的那一项，到 1972 年这项控制成了日记里的一行。
control 意为“自制力、约束”，祖父一月写道，整件事的自制力是一个习惯三十年的把持。
control 意为“控制、掌控”，我记得的是末尾那一种，他 1978 年保持住的，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
control 为抽象总称，祖母说一种自制是唯一会因为被考验而变好的东西。
